1:
AN ORDINANCE TO PROVIDE THAT THE JUDGES OF THE HALL COUNTY MAGISTRATE’S COURT SHALL SERVE AS THE JUDGES OF THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF CLERMONT; TO PROVIDE FOR FACILITIES AND COMPENSATION OF SUCH JUDGES BY AUTHORIZING THE COUNCIL OF CLERMONT TO ENTER INTO A CONTRACT WITH HALL COUNTY PROVIDING FOR THE SAME; TO PROVIDE FOR THE DUTIES AND AUTHORITY OF THE JUDGES OF THE MUNICIPAL COURT OF CLERMONT; TO PROVIDE THE JUDGES WITH A TERM OF OFFICE; AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by authority of the City Charter, Section 12, as amended, and 0.C.G.A. { 36-32-1 et seq., as amended:
2: This Ordinance shall be titled and known as, "The Judicial Appointment Ordinance."
3: as amended, and 0.C.G.A. { 36-32-2, as amended, the Town Council hereby appoints any and all duly authorized Magistrates of Hall County, and any judge substituting for said Magistrates under the Judicial Assistance Act to serve as Judge of the Municipal Court of Clermont, formerly known as the Mayor’s Court.
4:
The facilities of the Municipal Court and the compensation of the Magistrates that serve as Judges shall be that as determined by contract between the Board of Commissioners of Hall County, and the Town Council of Clermont. The Mayor, at the direction of the Council, is authorized to sign the contract on behalf of the Town, so long as the contract reflects the agreement of the governing authorities.

Pursuant to the authority of Section 12 of the Town Charter,
5:
The Magistrates when acting as Judges of the Municipal Court | of Clermont shall have the duties and authority as provided for | the Judge of the Municipal Court of Clermont, formerly known as the Mayor’s Court, in the Town Charter, as amended, and as provided by duly passed ordinances of the Town of Clermont.

| i
6: The Magistrates shall serve as Judges of the Municipal Court of Clermont at the will of the Council of Clermont. The service of the Magistrates as Judges may conclude at any time upon a duly passed ordinance of the Council of Clermont.
7:
If any paragraph, sub-paragraph, sentence, clause, phrase, or any portion of this Ordinance, shall be declared invalid or unconstitutional by any Court of competent jurisdiction or if the provisions of any part of this Ordinance as applied to any particular situation or set of circumstances shall be declared invalid or unconstitutional, such invalidity shall not be construed to affect the portions of this Ordinance not so held to be invalid, or the application of this Ordinance to other

circumstances not so held to be invalid. It is hereby declared to be the intent of the Town Council of the City of Clermont to provide for separate and divisible parts, and it does hereby adopt any and all parts hereof as amy not be held invalid for any reason.
8:
All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
